purpose: Show a response made as soon as someone assesses a situation.
keywords: Noticing that the customer looked cold, the shopkeeper turned up the heat.
Whenever he sees he is at a disadvantage, he changes the subject.
Once the bird judges it safe, it approaches the food.
restrictions: Often describes a characteristic reaction whenever the judgment is made.
mistake: The judgment belongs to the actor; it is not simply the narrator’s inference.
